la:other:oh.html:
oh, interj., an expression for the most various emotions of the mind—for surprise, both joyful and painful; for great pleasure or sorrow; for earnest wishing, admiration, aversion, etc.—
oh! O! ah! oh, tibi ego ut credam, furcifer? : oh, iniquus es,: oh perii!: oh, probus homo sum,.—Repeated, oh, oh, oh, as an exclamation of lamentation, : oh, oh, as an exclamation of exultation, (al. oh, al. ohoho).
